scope: Complete Savia/FLUJO fictional hackathon submission: deterministic core, implemented conversational enhancements, expandable architecture, data/ML/analytics and original evidence.

technical_judgment.reason: Pure ordered policy, host-bound ownership/consent, exact admission, receipt readback, idempotency and recovery are implemented and independently tested. Good reusable FLUJO/domain separation. Remaining point concerns integration/claim precision.

ai_engineering.reason: Integrated ES/PT voice, observable playback, two real bounded reviewer calls, durable inquiry/fleet contracts and canonical TTS narration. Specialist analysis is constrained to advice enums; current narration has source tests rather than a matched new recording, and human semantic/audio review is pending. Larger fleet completion is not a mandatory score gate.

data_engineering.reason: Contracts, quarantine, deterministic corrections, lineage, owner-sharded serving and atomic immutable publication are robust. Historical full data accounting and public fixture tests. Full refresh, static source inventory assumptions and measured high-concurrency lookup latency remain limits.

ml_evaluation.reason: Rejects template leakage; fixed diagnostic has train-only parameters, baselines, abstention tradeoffs, uncertainty and provenance. Luna outputs are verifiable but ten repeated phrases and a tying baseline are narrow. Explicit pre-submission human label adjudication remains pending.

data_analytics.reason: Useful product decisions from ownership/leakage/latency/safety measurements. Privacy-conscious read-only analytics validates host outcomes separately with clear denominators. Cost, exact query attribution, lifetime card outcomes and representative customer cohorts remain missing.

first_five_findings_discovery_order.finding: Complete implemented core and inspectable submission beyond the pitch, with explicit fictional-data and real-bank limits.
first_five_findings_discovery_order.later_verified: Substantive source and 1078 fresh core checks.

first_five_findings_discovery_order.finding: Headline ten-team/ready-to-scale language is stronger than the joined customer evidence: dated root model failure produced no accepted fleet result. Foundation capacity remains independently valuable; exact larger customer completion is separate scope.
Banking application authority and data stay outside general-purpose FLUJO main; reusable platform contracts are inspectable.

Dated vendor links and measurement caveats are good, but polished-voice-not-case rhetoric implies competitor limitations not established by repo evidence. Two-person attribution needs the same qualification as notes preserving three historic contributors.
Ownership and template-leakage diagnosis materially improve the product; frozen router labels remain AI-authored and the explicit pre-submission human adjudication requirement is pending.

comparison_quality.internal_baselines: Strong fixed keyword/raw learned/abstaining comparison with paired uncertainty, human miss and handoff-burden metrics; deterministic Luna baseline ties every oracle.
comparison_quality.commercial_reference: Useful dated positioning with vendor-reported scopes and no matched performance claim; rhetorical competitor absence and ready-to-scale language exceed measured evidence.
comparison_quality.live_customer_evidence: Original n=3 usefulness is 2/3 despite transport/history 3/3; post-fix PT n=1 uses deterministic host fallback and is correctly separate. Older narration omitted caveats; new canonical TTS source is tested, not relabeled as old live evidence.
comparison_quality.external_verification: None: repository-only constraint; linked vendor article/video were not opened.

limitations: No scikit-learn available; no installs, model retraining or fixed-model replay. Source, frozen datasets, provenance, metrics and errors inspected.
Historical organizer 5.9-million-row build not recomputed; public synthetic pipeline suites executed.
No full frontend build/current browser acceptance or external deployment verification.
No current human audio/semantic review, physical microphone test, provider replay or real-bank certification.
FLUJO subset exact-byte verified; upstream 104-test suite not rerun.
Source tests, historical recordings, provider/load tests and separate infrastructure exercises retain their own boundaries.

defects_and_gates.finding: Pending human label adjudication violates the holdout protocol's explicit before-final-submission evidence requirement.
defects_and_gates.scope: ML evaluation acceptance; not deterministic-core functionality.

defects_and_gates.finding: Capacity and competitive headlines can imply acceptance/advantage stronger than available evidence.

Cost, query attribution and lifetime card outcomes are not joined into operating analytics.
